extra.reason: Fixed in 3d0c508: from_json_bytes now runs the same simd-json parser as from_json_str/from_json_bytes_mut; the public serde Deserialize impl decodes the arbitrary_precision number token (const-parameter visitor mode, zero-cost on the simd path). Success-path + literal-magic-key + round-trip tests added. All gates green (conformance 1733/1733, clippy 121, fmt, wasm).

Fixed in 7dedd84: scan_regex consumes a backslash plus the full UTF-8 char it escapes as pattern text, so escaped brackets never move the depth counter (subsumes the old even/odd close-slash walk). docs/spec.md 2.5 updated, including a documented bidirectional deviation from jsonata-js on brackets preceded by an even number of backslashes (parity semantics chosen: /\\(x)/ lexes here, /\\}/ is S0302). 17 conformance cases + 6 lexer unit tests. Gates green (1750/1750, clippy 121).

Fixed in e6b387d: removed eval_chain's undefined short-circuit — every ~> stage now applies unconditionally, matching jsonata-js evaluateApplyExpression. Verified against a 45-expression jsonata-js matrix (all match post-fix; e.g. filter->count gives 0, substringAfter->exists gives false, undefined-propagating signatures still propagate). 13 conformance cases added, 9 of which fail on the old code. Gates green (1763/1763, clippy 121).

Fixed in daa49b5: mark_tail_position no longer sets thunk on a Function node carrying a group-by, so eval_group_by can never receive a TailCall sentinel. Note: reference jsonata-js is itself buggy here (drops the group, and leaks its own lambda sentinel for parenthesized callees), so the fix matches jsntrs's own non-tail semantics ({"k":{"v":1}}), which equal jsonata-js's non-tail semantics. 4 conformance cases + unit test. Gates green (1767/1767, clippy 121).

Fixed in 6129dab: collect_path_steps hoists a group-by found on any dot node in a flattened chain onto the resulting Path (S0210 if the chain carries more than one), matching jsonata-js processAST: a.b{G}.c behaves as (a.b.c){G}. Verified against jsonata-js on 10 expression/data variants (incl. arrays, chained groups, parenthesized forms). 9 conformance cases. Gates green (1776/1776, clippy 121).

Fixed in d85e80b: the array-constructor unwrap in fast_path::try_function is now restricted to //// via unwraps_array_constructor(kind), with the -deferral subtlety documented (([])=0 vs (undefined)=undefined is safe only because the Sum arm defers to the original AST on zero leaves). 32 differential divergences before, 0 after; 16 jsonata-js-verified expectations pinned in testdata. Gates green (1792/1792, clippy 121).

Fixed in dc6b434: fast_path::try_function now requires keep_array:false, group:None on the Function node, so $sum(prices)[] and $sum(prices){"k":$} fall through to the general path, mirroring collect_pure_path guards. 34 differential divergences before, 0 after; group-by shape pinned in testdata (jsonata-js-verified). The [] shape is deliberately NOT pinned in conformance: the general path itself diverges from jsonata-js there (filed as a follow-up). Gates green (1799/1799, clippy 121).

Fixed in 38c6905: extract_param_field now takes the Path node and mirrors fast_path::collect_pure_path (rejects keep_singleton_array on the Path and keep_array on the Name); three duplicate analyzer helpers collapsed into it so every lifted shape (FieldAccess, predicates, sort/reduce, concat templates, mapped-call args) shares one guarded predicate. 36 differential divergences before, 0 after; 9 jsonata-js-verified conformance cases. Gates green (1808/1808, clippy 121).
